columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Ingestion timestamp set to the time the record was received by the data collection endpoint.

columns.name: EventTimestamp
columns.description: ISO 8601 timestamp generated by the Function App at event creation time.

columns.name: SourceIp
columns.description: Synthetic source IP address of the network event.

columns.name: DestinationIp
columns.description: Synthetic destination IP address of the network event.

columns.name: Action
columns.description: Synthetic network action: ALLOW, DENY, DROP, or ALERT.

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: Synthetic severity level: informational, low, medium, high, or critical.

columns.name: Protocol
columns.description: Synthetic network protocol: TCP, UDP, or ICMP.

columns.name: BytesTransferred
columns.description: Synthetic byte count for the network flow.

columns.name: Message
columns.description: Static label identifying the record as a CCF Observability synthetic event.
